name: ai-team-kb
description: Connects Claude to one shared Confluence page where a team lists projects, findings and datasets others can reuse. Loads a local copy at session start, checks relevance on each prompt, and adds useful lines to the Inbox by itself, as targeted edits.

page_url.title: Team Confluence page link
page_url.description: Link to the team's AI Team Knowledge page in Confluence. The default is the team page; change it only to use a different page.
